The '''Yelsainian anti-tax insurrection''' occurred on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Yelsain/Legends|Yelsain]] during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]]. During the insurrection, [[Mishowan Shigormallan]] came to the attention of the [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]] and was harassed for several [[Standard month/Legends|months]].<ref name="RoE" />

After a few clashes with the hostile [[Yelsainian]]s, the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] decided to impose a 20 percent tax on all incoming and outgoing trade products. This tax did not measure up to the standard Imperial tax, but this solution was considered to be far more cost-effective than sending more [[Troop/Legends|troops]] against the Yelsainians.<ref name="TF" />
